{{Quote|The clone navy has attempted blockades of neutral systems throughout the provinces&hellip;but Tofen's Raiders ''smash'' them. Many Jedi have tried to stop him&hellip;and failed.|[[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]], commenting on Tofen Vane's exploits|<ref name="TCW11" />}}
A '''battle''' was fought during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] in a neutral [[Unidentified star system (Valahari Provinces)|star system]] within the [[Valahari sector/Legends|Valahari Provinces]]. After the people of the planet [[Valahari/Legends|Valahari]] took the side of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], the Republic was forced to establish [[Blockade/Legends|blockades]] of neutral systems of the Valahari Provinces that supplied military aid to the Separatists. An [[Unidentified Aqualish Jedi|Aqualish Jedi]] was placed in charge of one such blockade, along with a [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] of [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]] and [[V-19 Torrent starfighter/Legends|V-19 Torrent starfighters]]. Around [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], the [[Aqualish/Legends|Aqualish's]] forces were attacked by the Valahari [[Ace/Legends|ace]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Tofen Vane/Legends|Tofen Vane]] and his [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]], [[Tofen's Raiders/Legends|Tofen's Raiders]]. The Jedi flew a [[Delta-7B Aethersprite-class light interceptor/Legends|Delta-7B ''Aethersprite''-class light interceptor]] into battle, but was [[Death/Legends|killed]] by Vane. The Jedi's fleet was also destroyed.<ref name="TCW11" />
